notes.title: Workshop added
notes.content:
Players can now upload and download custom model kits via Steam Workshop!

[olist]
[*] a teleport point is added near the door. Look right (or snap turn right) and hold touchpad to teleport
[*] The new room has a separate desk and the user-generated-content placeholder will be loaded. Please see[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1222610/discussions/0/1735508653178169001/] discussion thread[/url] for more details on creating your custom model kit. 
[*] teleporting to "browse workshop" will allow you to download other player-created model kits. Use your controller to point at the "+" button and press trigger to download; ">" button will activate the model kit.
[*] teleporting to "upload your FBX" will allow you to upload your file. Use the VR keyboard to type and press "enter" to proceed from top-to-bottom. Once the "upload?" prompt is highlighted, press "y" on VR keyboard to confirm.
[/olist]
